bounded_statement: The report's selected result computes the failure intensity over the 126 telemetry-retained slots (21/126 = 0.1667) but explicitly asserts, in the selected-result line and a dedicated applicability line, that this intensity applies to the complete commissioned calendar of 168 slots, whose scientific target the task mandates; the 42 removed slots with unobserved outcomes are excluded from the denominator while the claim covers them.

counterevidence_considered.description: The report transparently discloses the subset denominator (126 retained, 42 removed), which could be argued to make the claim a conditional rate; however, transparency of the denominator does not neutralize the explicit statements that the rate targets and applies to the complete 168-slot calendar.

evidence.description: The workflow computes the intensity with the retained count as denominator, confirming the reported 0.1667 is a subset statistic.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to read the report as making only a conditional, retained-subset claim: the denominator is labeled 'telemetry-screened retained slots' and the accounting is complete. This reading fails because the selected-result line itself names 'the complete commissioned calendar', the scientific-target line names all 168 slots, and the applicability line affirmatively extends the subset intensity to the complete calendar; no scope-limiting statement or authorized deviation exists anywhere in the four files.

root_cause: The workflow divides retained events by retained_count rather than planned_count while the report text (also generated by the workflow) labels the result as describing the complete commissioned calendar, so a retained-subset statistic is presented as a complete-domain rate with no amendment or deviation authorizing the substitution.
